rationale: max_steps: 150 (~25 passes) plus diff_stall_gate max_stall 3 already bound runaway passes; a max_passes default above ~25 can never fire before max_steps and one below it routes to the same summarize_partial terminal — no distinct failure mode, only config surface. Repo-wide convention is that documented --context keys are declared and read; max_passes was the sole documented-but-unread exception.
rule: Option A: drop the dead --context max_passes=20 example from the issue's API/Interface section; continue-task's pass budget stays max_steps + diff_stall_gate
alternatives_rejected: Option B (implement the max_passes knob: context declaration + start_pass cap against pass-count.txt)
